name: – Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela – § 46 – Am 104
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 46. Welcomes the horizontal approach adopted by the Commission aimed at reducing the institutions’ budget estimates in order to comply with the principle of staff stability, as well as at limiting the increase in non-salary expenditure to 2 %, regardless of the new tasks entrusted to the institutions by the Commission and the co-legislators; emphasises the positive impact of this approach on Member States and, consequently, on the wallets of European citizens;
